_howto: GMP is filled in by hand. Every IPO card on ipo-gmp.html shows an ID (e.g. ID: SAMPINFRA). Under 'gmp' write that ID and the GMP in rupees: "SAMPINFRA": 38 or "DEMOFOOD": -12 (use null if there is no GMP yet). If the page shows 'Lot Size: TBA' (BSE-only SME IPOs), you can also give the lot: "MOCK-TEXTILES": {"gmp": 9, "lotSize": 2000}. Change 'updated' (IST time) every time you edit GMP. 'extraIpos' is only for an IPO that neither NSE nor BSE lists -- same fields as data/ipo-details.json plus 'gmp'.
